skills.name: git-commit-craft
skills.description: Write small, scoped, well-explained git commits instead of one giant dump of unrelated changes.

skills.name: shell-safety-review
skills.description: Sanity-check a shell command for destructive or irreversible side effects before running it, especially in an autonomous/unattended run.

skills.name: android-logcat-triage
skills.description: Systematically narrow down an Android app bug using adb logcat instead of guessing from the crash screenshot alone.

skills.name: agent-skill-authoring
skills.description: Write a well-formed SKILL.md (agentskills.io format) so it imports cleanly and actually gets used.

skills.name: daily-digest-composer
skills.description: Compose a scheduled digest (daily/weekly) that is skimmable in ten seconds instead of a raw dump of everything collected during the run.

skills.name: notification-triage
skills.description: Decide whether an incoming notification-triggered agent run actually warrants an action, instead of firing every time the trigger matches.

skills.name: social-post-drafting
skills.description: Draft a platform-appropriate social/chat post before an agent's Social Post action publishes it, instead of posting the raw run output.

skills.name: repo-maintenance-sweep
skills.description: Run a periodic repo-hygiene pass (stale branches, uncommitted work, dependency drift, stray TODOs) instead of letting small maintenance debt accumulate silently.

skills.name: web-research-brief
skills.description: Turn a browser-pane research session into a short, cited brief instead of handing back a pile of open tabs and raw page text.

skills.name: browser-change-watch
skills.description: Design a browser-pane page-change monitoring agent that alerts on a real change, not on every reload's incidental noise.

skills.name: privacy-local-only-analysis
skills.description: Keep a sensitive task strictly on-device (local LLM only), refusing the normal cloud-escalation ladder even when the local model struggles.

skills.name: code-review-checklist
skills.description: Review a diff systematically for correctness, safety, and test coverage before approving it, instead of skimming for obvious typos.

skills.name: test-coverage-gapfinder
skills.description: Find the highest-value untested code paths and propose tests for those first, instead of chasing a coverage percentage.

skills.name: dependency-audit
skills.description: Triage outdated and vulnerable dependencies by real upgrade risk before touching any lockfile, instead of bulk-bumping everything.

skills.name: disk-cleanup-triage
skills.description: Reclaim device or project storage by deleting genuinely reproducible files, never anything irreplaceable, and always showing what would be freed before deleting.

skills.name: meeting-notes-summarizer
skills.description: Turn raw meeting notes or a voice transcript into clear decisions and action items, instead of a re-formatted wall of everything that was said.

skills.name: rss-digest-curation
skills.description: Curate a list of feeds/sources into a skimmable digest by relevance, instead of forwarding every new item as noise.

skills.name: build-health-monitor
skills.description: Periodically check CI/build status and catch a regression trend early, instead of only noticing a broken build when someone hits it.

skills.name: translation-pass
skills.description: Add or update a translated string so it matches every locale's keys and tone, instead of leaving locale files out of sync.

skills.name: incident-postmortem
skills.description: Write a blameless postmortem that identifies the real root cause and a concrete follow-up, instead of a narrative that just restates what happened.
